description:
Obtainable Shroud and Threat
Construct "sane" versions of shroud and threat vessels using the Shrouded Substrate menu.
Dowload

Gallery

Spoiler

Changelog

Spoiler
v1.0.1
- Does NOT modify the vanilla Shroud and Threat hulls.
- All hulls have been **copied** and modified to have sane logistics/Flux/DP/OP stats.
- Threat hulls come with built in "Fragment Swarm" hullmod.
- Shroud hulls come with built in "Shrouded Mantle" hullmod.
- Maelstrom no longer crashes if you put beam weapons on it.
- Dollar sign is purely cosmetic as the function Alex made only works for weapons.

Please let me know if you experience any crashes/balans issues.

aiDescription: Adds constructable versions of Shroud and Threat vessels with balanced stats. These ships are built using the Shrouded Substrate menu and feature modified logistics, Flux, DP, and OP values. Threat variants include the Fragment Swarm hullmod, while Shroud variants include the Shrouded Mantle hullmod.
